title: Strict quotient and inverse-image Roos notation
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $W$, use its small pro-etale site with the fixed independent universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention], completed integral coefficient sheaf $\widehat R_W$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and ordinary unbounded module-sheaf derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $B_{W,n}=(R/\varpi^{n+1})_W$. Define $D_W(Q)$ to be the entire strict tower $Q\otimes_{\widehat R_W}B_{W,n}$ restricted to completed modules, with its actual quotient transitions [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus, lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. For an isomorphism $g:X\to Y$, let $G$ be the exact coefficient-transported inverse image [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison], let $G_{\rm cx}$ and $G_{\rm tow}$ be its termwise complex and tower functors, and put $T_D=1-s_D$ and $T_{GD}=1-s_{GD}$ on the respective countable products. Define $\phi_D:G_{\rm cx}(\prod D_n)\to\prod G_{\rm cx}D_n$ by the canonical product projections. For the simultaneous coefficient calculus $S$ [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus] and normalized Roos model $r$ [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models], define the predicate on a natural isomorphism $\rho$ from $q$ followed by $S.{\rm reduction}$ and total limit to $D_W$ followed by $H$ and derived localization $Q$: for every good representative $P$, every strict simultaneous system $K$ and specified whole-system adjunction-coherent derived presentation $e$ with finite comparisons $\kappa_n$, there is a strict tower isomorphism $a$ from the completed restriction of $K$ to $D_W(P)$, taking the restricted section $x$ to $\kappa_n(x)$, and $\rho_P=QH(a)\circ r_K\circ{\rm limit}(e)$. Here $q$ is good-representative localization, and $H$ is the actual mapping cocone of $1-s$. The six strict quotient and inverse-image constructions are unchanged; the completion normalization requires the existing whole-system adjunction coherence, which fixes e before taking any limit.

proof.text: Keep the strict quotient, inverse-image, difference and product constructions. In the completion normalization test the same section and derived-limit equations on presentations satisfying IsIntegralComparisonPresentationCoherent. This pins e by injective adjunction Hom bijections to the strict tensor-unit map specified by kappa. It excludes the invisible derived twists allowed by finite evaluations alone. Canonical ordinary/derived quotient presentations satisfy this equation by their Hom normalization.
